title: Fake netherite cyan terracotta
description: turns an unused block (cyan glazed terracotta) into netherite, perfect for server owners and members to make cool stashes or bases without it being expensive
body:
Turns an unused block (cyan glazed terracotta) into netherite, perfect for server owners and members to make cool stashes or bases without it being expensive.
It's meant to be a server texture pack so that that way nobody can see it's fake until it's mined.

Also renames it to fake netherite.
